programs.notes: Single university-wide PhD program ('research and graduate education in the biomedical sciences, chemistry, and biophysics'); students are mentored by heads of laboratories. Page also lists 'Program title: Physics Program codes: 22044 (MS), 09332 (PhD)'. No relevant author matched on the laboratories list or tri-institutional professors page. Jialong Jiang (peripheral, A) matched only on https://www.rockefeller.edu/our-scientists/independent-fellows/ as 'Fellow' (independent fellow, not a head of laboratory), so not recorded as program faculty. The grad page also links a Tri-Institutional 'chemical biology Ph.D. program' (http://chembio.triiprograms.org/), not examined because there are no direction-B authors.
